svg.title: Roof eave edge, layer by layer
svg.desc: A cutaway of a roof eave. Metal drip edge is nailed to the roof deck first and turns down over the fascia. Ice and water shield goes on next and laps over the drip edge, running from the eave to at least 24 inches inside the exterior wall line, measured along the slope. Synthetic underlayment laps over the top of the ice and water shield. The starter strip and the first course of shingles hang a little past the drip edge so water drips clear. Illustration, not a photo of an actual job. Layer thicknesses are exaggerated so each one can be seen.
svg.text: Drip edge first. Ice barrier over it.

g.text: Nailed to the deck at the eave,
Laps OVER the eave drip edge,
runs 24 in+ past the wall line

svg.text: Illustration · not a photo of an actual job
